standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of properties
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers representability, surjectivity and smoothness of U -> X to the base-changed morphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: Representable diagonal computes fibres
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the source of the base-changed morphism is an algebraic space.

standard_prerequisites.name: Smooth cover criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes the target fibre product is an algebraic stack.

core_obligations: Fix a smooth cover U -> X and an object xi of Y over T; show the base-changed morphism between the two fibre products is smooth surjective with algebraic-space source, hence its target is algebraic.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the fibre products over xi, transfer properties by base change, identify the source via the diagonal, and close with the criterion.
difficulty_reason: Three-step reduction in the fibre-product model.
